# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2010

**Pre-Closing Special Budget for Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2009**

## Summary

This ordinance approves the pre-closing special budget for the fiscal year ended December 31, [[2009]]. It appropriates savings from unexpended appropriations amounting to Two Hundred Forty Eight Thousand Nine Hundred Thirty Five Pesos & 25/100 (₱ 248,935.25) and an overdraft appropriation of Two Hundred Forty Eight Thousand Seventy Five Pesos & 83/100 (₱ 248,075.83) to cover overdraft in appropriation to make the expenditures for the year [[2009]] proper and legal. The Pre-Closing special Budget prepared by the Municipal Budget Officer is attached as an integral part of this ordinance.

## Key Provisions

1.  At the close of Business on December 31, [[2009]] there is a savings from all unexpended appropriation of various offices in the amount of Two Hundred Forty Eight Thousand Nine Hundred Thirty Five Pesos & 25/100 (₱ 248,935.25) and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Two Hundred Forty Eight Thousand Seventy Five Pesos & 83/100 (₱ 248,075.83) and unappropriated balance of Eight Hundred Fifty Nine & 42/100 (₱ 859.42).
2.  The amount of Two Hundred Forty Eight Thousand Seventy Five Pesos & 83/100 (₱ 248,075.83) is hereby appropriated to cover up overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Two Hundred Forty Eight Thousand Seventy Five Pesos & 83/100 (₱ 248,075.83) to make the expenditures for the year [[2009]] proper and legal.
3.  The Pre-Closing special Budget prepared by the Municipal Budget Officer is hereby attached and made as an integral part of this ordinance and marked as "Annex A".
